scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducible finite tests are supplied. Only the sharp modulus-uniform spectral asymptotic and its rank-one localization are assessed as substantive new findings; no claim of originality is made for classical meet-matrix inversion. Finite tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed radius as dimension grows. No growing-radius or complete finite singular spectrum result. An earlier general meet-matrix inverse theorem covers the algebraic factorization. Historical priority of the uniform condition-number asymptotic remains subject to independent study.
title: Uniform angular conditioning of sparse Boolean-word Fourier minors
